title: Verify: Base typography and backdrop CSS unit tests
summary: Unit test reads styles.css text and asserts the base rules.
description: Write tests/baseTypography.test.ts that reads src/styles.css with node:fs and asserts the rules, from R1 acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: body rule uses ink-1, parchment-5, VT323 20px
h1,h2 use the pixel font and sf-dialog exists
technical_constraints: Filesystem reads only the repo stylesheet

steps.action: Add test 'base rules' that readFileSync's src/styles.css and expects it to match /body\s*{[^}]*var\(--sf-color-ink-1\)/, /var\(--sf-color-parchment-5\)/, /font-size:\s*20px/, /h1, h2\s*{[^}]*--sf-font-pixel/, and contain '.sf-dialog' and '.sf-fullscreen-bg'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/baseTypography.test.ts
